# Agent Development Pull Request Template

## Description
- **What** was implemented?
- **Why** was this change needed?
- Reference any relevant design docs or research.

## Related Issues
- Closes #<issue-number> (requirements epic or sub‑task)

## Verification
- List test commands to run.
- Expected outcome / screenshots.
- Verify coverage >= 80%.

## Documentation
- Updated docs? (Yes/No)
- Link to generated diagram or architecture spec.

---
**Checklist**
- [ ] Code follows the repository style guide.
- [ ] Tests added and passing.
- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] CI passed.
